Boo — panel redesign + the audio fix

Two problems, both here as design before any code.

LEFT: the panel redrawn. Blurred mood-coloured bloom behind dark glass, editorial serif for the sentence, tabular mono for the numbers. Three figures side by side instead of four stacked rows.

RIGHT: why it always thinks music is playing, diagnosed on your machine, plus every edge case the fix has to handle.
Diagnosed, not yet built — say go and I write it.
